categories.main_business_segments: Hisense Home Appliances Group primarily operates in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of home appliances including HVAC systems (central and household air conditioners), refrigerators, freezers, washing machines, kitchen appliances, automotive air conditioner compressors, and integrated thermal management systems. The company also provides full-scenario smart home solutions centered on intelligent upgrading of household appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with over 2,000 patents and focuses on vacuum preservation technology, AI-driven smart home appliances, energy-efficient HVAC systems, and integrated thermal management for new energy vehicles. Manufacturing incorporates digital transformation, intelligent operation management, automation, AI, and 5G technologies, with a commitment to green manufacturing and low-carbon technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hisense serves a broad customer base including residential consumers, commercial and industrial clients, and automotive manufacturers. Key markets include high-end households, property fitting-out furnishing projects, industrial retrofitting, and new energy vehicle manufacturers. The company targets diversified consumer groups with scenario-based smart home solutions and health-oriented appliances.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in domestic China and has a significant overseas presence across Europe, Americas, Middle East and Africa, Asia-Pacific, and ASEAN regions. It has established 36 industrial parks and production bases worldwide, with localized R&D centers and offices in key markets to support global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hisense operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, encompassing R&D, manufacturing, marketing, and after-sales services. It also integrates upstream activities by optimizing supplier structures and promoting regional integrated procurement to enhance supply chain efficiency and localization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include breakthroughs in core technologies for energy efficiency, health, AI-driven smart appliances, and low-carbon solutions. The company invests heavily in R&D with over 3.4 billion RMB spent in 2024, focusing on intelligent preservation, smart operation, green materials, and integrated thermal management systems. Digital transformation and global R&D system expansion are key innovation themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of home appliances and automotive components. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels, with increasing emphasis on online platforms and overseas markets. It also leverages government subsidy policies to stimulate demand and supports revenue through after-sales services and smart home ecosystem solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hisense is a leading player in China's home appliance industry with strong market shares domestically and growing influence overseas. It competes with other major appliance manufacturers in HVAC, refrigeration, and automotive thermal management sectors. The company positions itself as a technology-driven, innovation leader with a diversified brand portfolio including Hisense, Ronshen, Kelon, Hitachi, York, Gorenje, ASKO, and Sanden.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hisense Home Appliances achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 92.75 billion, an 8.35% year-on-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.35 billion, up 17.99%. The company has demonstrated consistent growth with a 16% compounded revenue growth rate over the past decade and continues to expand its overseas revenue, which grew 27.59% in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hisense emphasizes technology-based innovation, user-centered design, and scenario-based smart home solutions to deliver differentiated products. Its unique value lies in advanced vacuum preservation, AI-enabled air quality management, energy-efficient HVAC systems, and integrated thermal management for new energy vehicles. The company also focuses on aesthetic design, health features, and sustainability to meet evolving consumer demands.
